entities.name: Statuary Garden
entities.description: Ceremonial space within Aradara Station in Ghirapur where statues of the city's greatest inventors stand.

entities.name: Aradara Station
entities.description: Great rail hub of Ghirapur where four aether-propelled train lines converge, under a central dome.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Region of Kaladesh whose people visit Ghirapur.

entities.name: Aradaras
entities.description: Legendary mother-and-son inventors who perfected the city's first aether-powered trains.

entities.name: Dukhara Canal
entities.description: Historic canal spanned by eleven bridges.

entities.name: Eleven Bridges
entities.description: District with eleven grand bridges built to symbolize noble houses setting aside differences.

entities.name: War of Eleven
entities.description: War waged by noble houses before they agreed to trade in peace.

events.summary: The Aradaras perfect the design for Ghirapur's first aether-powered trains.
events.quote: the legendary mother-and-son team of inventors who perfected the design for the city's first aether-powered trains

events.summary: The Statuary Garden begins with statues of the Aradaras and later grows with other inventors.
events.quote: The Statuary Garden began with statues of the Aradaras themselves

events.summary: Eleven bridges are built over the Dukhara Canal to symbolize the noble houses of the War of Eleven setting aside their differences.
events.quote: spanned by eleven grand bridges built to symbolize the willingness of the noble houses who once waged the War of Eleven to set aside their differences

relations.quote: This revered garden lies directly beneath the soaring central dome of Aradara Station
the magnificent rail hub that serves as the beating heart of Ghirapur's transport network

relations.note: The station is named in their honor.
relations.quote: The station itself is named in honor of the Aradaras
